create_RobotTCPSensor: create a RobotTCPSensor instance from a gripper and name to measure TCP pose and velocity
initialize_episode_RobotTCPSensor: initialize the RobotTCPSensor for a new episode using physics and random state
get_observables_RobotTCPSensor: get the observables dictionary from a RobotTCPSensor to access measurable quantities
get_name_RobotTCPSensor: get the name property of a RobotTCPSensor which appends _tcp to the provided name
get_obs_key_RobotTCPSensor: get the observation key string for a given Observations enum value from RobotTCPSensor
